name: AKTOR
verdict: AKTOR is the brand of AKTOR Group, an Athens-listed infrastructure group (formerly Intrakat) whose largest holder is the chairman's company Winex Investments (33.41%). Nothing found.
note: Rating note: naming sponsor of Panathinaikos B.C. (the team plays as Panathinaikos AKTOR Athens; naming deal renewed to 2028-29 per the AKTOR press release of 5 Nov 2024). AKTOR Group is listed on the Athens Stock Exchange (AKTR); WINEX INVESTMENTS LIMITED, linked to chairman/CEO Alexandros Exarchou, holds 33.41% of voting rights (July 2026). No state or state fund named among the holders; no human-rights finding against the group found.
